title: Riyadh
sideASummary: Player deck back. No printed text. State 2 side A is the same back.
sideBSummary: Riyadh, 24°42'49"N 46°40'31"E, code P2-09b. Compass has no anchor. One sealed box labeled SEARCH:. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: Immediately take 1 Player card from the discard pile and add it to your hand. The printed label is SEARCH:. The scratch calls this the Hollow Men headquarters: the city lives in fear of them, they come from Asia, and new members appear every year in November. No companion stays on the card.

states.summary: SEARCH is scratched. Hollow Men have their headquarters here. The city lives in fear of them. They come from Asia, and new members appear every year in November. Immediately take 1 Player card from the discard pile and add it to your hand. Code P2-09b is unchanged. Side A is the player back.

rules: Black Player card for Riyadh. Not a port.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is the scratched face.
Scratching it immediately takes 1 Player card from the Player discard pile into your hand. No companion.
notes: Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
The card does not say what to do if the Player discard pile is empty.
The scratch panel fills the center. No bullseye upgrade mark is printed.
